import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration for file paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

# Create submission directory if needed
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(SUBMISSION_PATH), exist_ok=True)


def main():
    try:
        # Load datasets
        train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
        test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
        sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

        id_col = "id"
        target_col = "target"

        # Extract feature columns starting with 'f_'
        feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col.startswith("f_")]

        # Define categorical features based on data overview
        categorical_columns = ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]

        # Convert categorical columns to proper 'category' dtype BEFORE preprocessing/featuresplit
        for cat_col in categorical_columns:
            train_df[cat_col] = (
                pd.to_datetime(train_df[cat_col]).dt.astype("category")
                if hasattr(pd.to_datetime, "__call__")
                else train_df[cat_col].astype("category")
            )
            train_df[cat_col] = train_df[cat_col].astype("category")

        # Select model features (excluding f_28 which is float per problem description)
        model_feature_cols = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in ["f_28"]]

        # Filter out non-feature columns
        X_train = train_df[model_feature_cols].copy()
        y_train = train_df[target_col].values
        X_test = test_df[model_feature_cols].copy()

        # Convert all features to proper numeric/categorical dtypes
        for col in model_feature_cols:
            if col not in categorical_columns:
                X_train[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_train[col])
                X_test[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_test[col])

        for col in categorical_columns:
            if col in model_feature_cols:
                X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype("category")
                X_test[col] = X_test[col].astype("category")

        # Split into train and validation (hold-out set NEVER touched during training)
        X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
            X_train.copy(),
            y_train.copy(),
            test_size=0.2,
            random_state=42,
            shuffle=False,
        )

        # Initialize LightGBM Classifier
        params = {
            "objective": "binary",
            "metric": "auc",
            "random_state": 42,
            "verbose": -1,
            "min_child_samples": 20,
            "subsample": 0.8,
            "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
            "learning_rate": 0.1,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "max_depth": -1,
        }

        model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)

        # Specify categorical features for LightGBM handling
        model.categorical_feature = categorical_columns

        def get_pred(data):
            return model.predict_proba(data)[:, 1]

        # Train model with early stopping
        model.fit(
            X_train_full,
            y_train_full,
            eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
        )

        # Evaluate on hold-out validation set (NOT used in training)
        val_preds = get_pred(X_val)
        val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
        print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (Hold-out): {val_auc:.4f}")

        # Predict on Test set
        test_predictions = get_pred(X_test)

        # Prepare Submission DataFrame matching sample submission format
        submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
            {id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: test_predictions}
        )

        # Save to submission directory
        submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
        print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")

        print(f"\nFinal AUC-ROC on Hold-out Validation Set: {val_auc:.4f}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error occurred: {e}")
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
